internal_split: leave one complete match out of the four training matches
family_selection: mean official spellF1 equally weighted over matches and three conditions; within 0.005 of best retain fewest input columns
temporal_selection: mean spellF1 of each setting and its Manhattan neighbours; within 0.005 of best neighbourhood prefer higher short-possession recall, then lower total switching scale
final_test: locked; milestone 7 after a final freeze
validation_caveat: The two validation matches have already been inspected in milestones 4/5. They are a confirmation set, not a new blind test.
